_comment: Second held-out set of PILOT sentences for masker recall (S1.3, FR-140), labelled by hand on 2026-10-05 after the fixes driven by labelled-pilot.json and before the masker was run on it. Unbiased result then: 31/33 (93.9%); misses: a month and year ('April 2019') and an exchange list ('00975-02-(...)'). Both were then fixed, so this set is no longer unbiased: the next honest figure needs a new set labelled from the pilot snapshots. Phone numbers synthetic.
